paragraphs.source_en: Azai Bizen-no-kami Nagamasa watched the torches lighting the way for Oichi and the children merge with the bonfires of the Kyōgoku enclosure, then assembled the remnants of his force. As agreed, he was to surrender the main castle to the enemy, lead his men down the mountain, and proceed to Nobunaga's headquarters on Mount Toragozen.
